name: Commit // Memory
clause: Aftermath  /  Put target spell or nonland permanent into its owner's library second from the top.

needs.proposedSignature: `move` gains `posFromTop?: number` (or `pos: 'top' | 'bottom' | { fromTop: number }`): { op: 'move', what: { kind: 'spell-or-nonland-permanent' }, to: 'library', posFromTop: 2 }
needs.semantics: Put an object into its owner's library that many cards from the top (Commit, Time Ebb variants, Condescend-style tuck effects). Today `pos` is only 'top' | 'bottom', so the clause can only be written by playing a different card.
needs.clause: Put target spell or nonland permanent into its owner's library second from the top.

needs.proposedSignature: AltCost id 'aftermath': { id: 'aftermath', label: 'aftermath', cost: { mana: <that half's own mana cost> }, from: 'graveyard', exileAfter: true, onlyFrom: 'graveyard' } declared on the script's `secondFace` + COVER_RULES.altCosts shape /^aftermath$/ + KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS.aftermath = 'cast ~ only from your graveyard. then exile it'
needs.semantics: Cast this half only from your graveyard (never from hand), for its own mana cost, and exile it as it leaves the stack. Mechanically flashback with the printed cost and a 'graveyard only' restriction; `cast-from` is not a substitute (it is a battlefield static and would permit casting every card from the graveyard).
